ruleDefinitions.name: WinSxS Executable File Creation By Non-System Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of binaries in the WinSxS folder by non-system processes

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Systems32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
